typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EBillPreferenceArchiveFilePath as string (),
	EBillPreferenceFilePath as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutFileName as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutPath as string (),
	FacetsDataSource as string (),
	FacetsPassword as string (),
	FacetsUserID as string (),
	TestVaraible as string (),
	varFilePath as string ()
}

source(output(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		MESSAGE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT    EPS.GRGR_ID,    EPS.SBSB_ID,    EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT,    EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT,    \'Member does not have a matching Opt-IN\' AS MESSAGE  FROM    AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS     LEFT JOIN AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF EP ON EP.GRGR_ID= EPS.GRGR_ID AND EP.SBSB_ID= EPS.SBSB_ID AND EP.EBILL_EFF_DT = to_date(EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT, \'yyyy-mm-dd\')  WHERE  LTRIM(RTRIM(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT)) <> \'8888-08-08\' AND EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(RTRIM(EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT)) > 9 AND  EP.GRGR_ID IS NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> InValidDateOverlap
InValidDateOverlap sink(input(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		MESSAGE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EBILL_EFF_DT,
		MESSAGE,
		GRGR_ID,
		EBILL_TERM_DT,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> FlatFileDestination
